descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks
• As Dipl. You keep an overview of all tasks, set priorities and ensure that everything runs smoothly.
• You are everywhere in the clinic, assist with recordings, alarms and acute situations and are available as a reliable contact person.
• Through your constant contact with all stations, you actively contribute to a good working environment and a safe environment.
• You take on short-term responsibility at stations, support during entry and exit and are on site for crisis talks or special situations.
• Checking on the psychotherapy stations, giving out reserve medications and helping with pikettan calls are part of your daily tasks.
• You ensure that everything runs smoothly, from the opening of the entrance door after closing hours to spontaneous missions, always with experience and expertise. Your profile
• You have an education as a Dipl. Nursing professional completed HF / FH (for foreign training, recognition or a positive PreCheck by the Swiss Red Cross is required) and has already gained experience in psychiatry.
• Night services in the team of two are mastered confidently, even in complex situations calm and overview is maintained.
• You have social skills, are resilient, work independently and independently and can work well together in interdisciplinary teams.
• Good computer skills make administrative tasks easier, very good knowledge of German (at least C1) is required. With around 1,400 employees, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. We are on the road digitally and are committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage. As soon as your application has been received by us online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. We are happy to get to know you based on your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. Then we will contact you. During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. In the second round we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. You also get the opportunity to get to know your future team. You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide for you after the second interview and ask you if you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will draw up your contract. In the following days we will send you the contract by post in double. The contract also provides you with relevant information about your employment. Between the acceptance of the job and the first working day, you as a new employee can already access relevant internal information. So you can get a differentiated picture of the company and already prepare for the job. On the first day you can expect an onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues. You set up at the new workplace and get an overview of your next tasks. You also get your individual introduction plan, which helps you to find your way around quickly.

• Les services de nuit dans l'équipe de deux sont maîtrisés avec confiance, même dans des situations complexes calme et l'aperçu est maintenu.
• Vous avez des compétences sociales, êtes résilient, travaillez de façon indépendante et indépendante et pouvez travailler ensemble dans des équipes interdisciplinaires.
• De bonnes compétences en informatique facilitent les tâches administratives, il faut une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand (au moins C1).

• Im Rahmen der Massnahme und der Kernteamarbeit wirkst du eng mit der therapeutischen Fallführung an der Umsetzung der Therapiepläne sowie an lockerungsrelevanten Entscheidungen mit.
• Du planst und gestaltest milieutherapeutische Aktivitäten, beteiligst dich an interprofessionellen Fallbesprechungen und dokumentierst die Behandlungsprozesse sorgfältig.
• In akuten Situationen handelst du sicher, führst Kriseninterventionen und deeskalierende Massnahmen durch und stellst die Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Hygienestandards sicher.

descriptionByLocale.it:
I tuoi compiti
• Tu nutri e sosteni i pazienti forensi tenendo conto delle loro esigenze psicologiche individuali e promuovendo la loro indipendenza nella vita quotidiana.
• Nell'ambito della misura e del core team di lavoro, si lavora a stretto contatto con la gestione dei casi terapeutici sull'attuazione dei piani terapeutici e sulle decisioni di rilassamento-rilevante.
• Pianifica e progetta attività milieuterapeutiche, partecipa a discussioni di casi interprofessionali e documenta attentamente i processi di trattamento.
• In situazioni acute, si agisce in modo sicuro, effettuare interventi di crisi e misure di de-escalation e garantire il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e igiene.
• L'educazione e la consulenza dei pazienti e dei parenti fanno parte dei vostri compiti come supporto attivo dei nostri studenti HF e degli studenti FaGe nella formazione professionale. Il tuo profilo
• Hai completato con successo la tua formazione come infermiera HF o FH e hai un riconoscimento SRK o un positivo SRK PreCheck in una laurea straniera.
• Idealmente, hai già esperienza professionale in psichiatria, preferibilmente in assistenza forense.
• Con il vostro alto senso di responsabilità, comprendete i requisiti speciali della cura forense e agire con calma e professionalità anche in situazioni difficili.
• Ti piace lavorare in un team, apprezzare la cooperazione interprofessionale e portare la resilienza necessaria per un ambiente di lavoro esigente.
• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco almeno livello C1 e buona conoscenza IT e organizzativa vi supportano nella comunicazione professionale e nei compiti amministrativi. Con circa 1.400 dipendenti, forniamo un trattamento psichiatrico accessibile, personale ed efficace e la cura per gli adulti nei cantoni di St.Gallen e Appenzell Ausserrhoden così come nel Principato del Liechtenstein nelle nostre nove sedi aziendali. Siamo sulla strada digitalmente e siamo impegnati alla sostenibilità, quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online tramite la nostra homepage. Non appena la vostra domanda è stata ricevuta da noi online, riceverete una conferma della ricevuta via e-mail. Siamo lieti di conoscervi sulla base del vostro dossier e verificare se le vostre qualifiche, competenze e voi come persona si adattano alla posizione pubblicizzata e la psichiatria St.Gallen. Allora ti contatteremo. Durante un'intervista personale ci conosceremo e imparerete di più sulla psichiatria St.Gallen, la posizione pubblicizzata e le sfide. Nel secondo round vorremmo ottenere un'immagine ancora migliore di voi e scoprire insieme a voi se ci adattiamo insieme. Hai anche l'opportunità di conoscere la tua squadra futura. Riceverete una conferma telefonica da noi se decidiamo per voi dopo la seconda intervista e vi chiediamo se siete ancora convinti di noi. Se siamo d'accordo, prepareremo il tuo contratto. Nei giorni seguenti ti invieremo il contratto per posta in doppio. Il contratto ti fornisce anche informazioni rilevanti sul tuo lavoro. Tra l'accettazione del lavoro e il primo giorno lavorativo, l'utente come nuovo dipendente può già accedere a informazioni interne rilevanti. Così si può ottenere un quadro differenziato della società e già prepararsi per il lavoro. Il primo giorno ci si può aspettare un onboarding nel vostro nuovo team e con altri colleghi. È impostato sul nuovo posto di lavoro e ottenere una panoramica delle vostre prossime attività. Si ottiene anche il vostro piano di introduzione individuale, che vi aiuta a trovare il vostro senso intorno rapidamente.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks
• You nurture and support forensic patients taking into account their individual psychological needs and promoting their independence in everyday life.
• As part of the measure and the core team work, you work closely with the therapeutic case management on the implementation of the therapy plans as well as on relaxation-relevant decisions.
• You plan and design milieutherapeutic activities, participate in interprofessional case discussions and carefully document the treatment processes.
• In acute situations, you act safely, carry out crisis interventions and de-escalating measures and ensure compliance with safety and hygiene standards.
• The education and advice of patients and relatives is just as much a part of your tasks as the active support of our HF students and FaGe learners in vocational training. Your profile
• You have successfully completed your training as a nurse HF or FH and have an SRK recognition or a positive SRK PreCheck at a foreign degree.
• Ideally, you already have professional experience in psychiatry, preferably in forensic care.
• With your high sense of responsibility, you understand the special requirements of forensic care and act calmly and professionally even in difficult situations.
• You enjoy working in a team, appreciate the interprofessional cooperation and bring the necessary resilience for a demanding working environment.
• Very good knowledge of German at least level C1 as well as good IT and organizational knowledge support you in professional communication and administrative tasks. With around 1,400 employees, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. We are on the road digitally and are committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage. As soon as your application has been received by us online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. We are happy to get to know you based on your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. Then we will contact you. During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. In the second round we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. You also get the opportunity to get to know your future team. You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide for you after the second interview and ask you if you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will draw up your contract. In the following days we will send you the contract by post in double. The contract also provides you with relevant information about your employment. Between the acceptance of the job and the first working day, you as a new employee can already access relevant internal information. So you can get a differentiated picture of the company and already prepare for the job. On the first day you can expect an onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues. You set up at the new workplace and get an overview of your next tasks. You also get your individual introduction plan, which helps you to find your way around quickly.

Tasks:
• You nurture and support forensic patients taking into account their individual psychological needs and promoting their independence in everyday life.
• As part of the measure and the core team work, you work closely with the therapeutic case management on the implementation of the therapy plans as well as on relaxation-relevant decisions.
• You plan and design milieutherapeutic activities, participate in interprofessional case discussions and carefully document the treatment processes.
• In acute situations, you act safely, carry out crisis interventions and de-escalating measures and ensure compliance with safety and hygiene standards.
• The education and advice of patients and relatives is just as much a part of your tasks as the active support of our HF students and FaGe learners in vocational training.

Requirements
• You have successfully completed your training as a nurse HF or FH and have an SRK recognition or a positive SRK PreCheck at a foreign degree.
• Ideally, you already have professional experience in psychiatry, preferably in forensic care.
• With your high sense of responsibility, you understand the special requirements of forensic care and act calmly and professionally even in difficult situations.
• You enjoy working in a team, appreciate the interprofessional cooperation and bring the necessary resilience for a demanding working environment.
• Very good knowledge of German at least level C1 as well as good IT and organizational knowledge support you in professional communication and administrative tasks.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vos tâches
• Vous nourrissez et soutenez les patients légistes en tenant compte de leurs besoins psychologiques individuels et en favorisant leur indépendance dans la vie quotidienne.
• Dans le cadre de la mesure et de l'équipe de base, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec la gestion des cas thérapeutiques sur la mise en œuvre des plans thérapeutiques ainsi que sur les décisions relatives à la relaxation.
• Vous planifiez et concevez des activités thérapeutiques, participez à des discussions interprofessionnelles et documentez soigneusement les processus de traitement.
• Dans les situations aiguës, vous agissez en toute sécurité, effectuez des interventions de crise et des mesures de désescalade et veillez au respect des normes de sécurité et d'hygiène.
• L'éducation et les conseils des patients et des membres de la famille sont autant une partie de vos tâches que le soutien actif de nos étudiants HF et des apprenants FaGe dans la formation professionnelle. Votre profil
• Vous avez réussi votre formation en tant qu'infirmière HF ou FH et avez obtenu une reconnaissance SRK ou une prévérification SRK positive à un diplôme étranger.
• Idéalement, vous avez déjà une expérience professionnelle en psychiatrie, de préférence en médecine légale.
• Avec votre sens élevé des responsabilités, vous comprenez les exigences spéciales des soins médico-légaux et agissez calmement et professionnellement même dans des situations difficiles.
• Vous aimez travailler en équipe, apprécier la coopération interprofessionnelle et apporter la résilience nécessaire pour un environnement de travail exigeant.
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand au moins niveau C1 ainsi que de bonnes connaissances informatiques et organisationnelles vous soutiennent dans les tâches professionnelles de communication et administratives. Avec environ 1 400 employés, nous offrons un traitement psychiatrique accessible, personnel et efficace aux adultes dans les cantons de Saint-Gall et Appenzell Ausserrhoden ainsi qu'en Principauté du Liechtenstein dans nos neuf établissements. Nous sommes sur la route numériquement et nous nous engageons pour la durabilité, donc nous attendons avec impatience votre application en ligne via notre page d'accueil. Dès que votre demande a été reçue par nous en ligne, vous recevrez une confirmation de réception par courriel. Nous sommes heureux de vous connaître sur la base de votre dossier et de vérifier si vos qualifications, compétences et vous en tant que personne correspondent au poste annoncé et à la psychiatrie St.Gallen. Alors nous vous contacterons. Lors d'une entrevue personnelle, nous apprenons à nous connaître et vous en apprendrez plus sur la psychiatrie St.Gallen, le poste annoncé et les défis. Au deuxième tour, nous aimerions avoir une meilleure image de vous et découvrir avec vous si nous nous marions. Vous avez également l'occasion de connaître votre future équipe. Vous recevrez une confirmation téléphonique de notre part si nous décidons pour vous après la deuxième entrevue et vous demandons si vous êtes toujours convaincu de nous. Si nous sommes d'accord, nous établirons votre contrat. Dans les jours suivants, nous vous enverrons le contrat par la poste en double. Le contrat vous fournit également des informations pertinentes sur votre emploi. Entre l'acceptation de l'emploi et le premier jour ouvrable, vous en tant que nouvel employé pouvez déjà accéder aux informations internes pertinentes. Ainsi, vous pouvez obtenir une image différenciée de l'entreprise et déjà préparer pour le travail. Le premier jour, vous pouvez vous attendre à être embarqué dans votre nouvelle équipe et avec d'autres collègues. Vous vous installez sur le nouveau lieu de travail et obtenez un aperçu de vos prochaines tâches. Vous obtenez également votre plan d'introduction individuel, ce qui vous aide à trouver votre chemin rapidement.

È impostato sul nuovo posto di lavoro e ottenere una panoramica delle vostre prossime attività. • Together with your caregivers, you develop individual goals and strategies.
• You bring your ideas and actively shape the further development of our residential group.

• After a well-founded introduction, you also take on daily responsibility.
• It is possible to take on vocational training and accompany students and learners.
• If interested and appropriately suited, there is also the prospect of taking over the deputy residential group management. Your profile
• You have completed training as a nurse HF (for foreign training, SRK recognition or a positive PreCheck is required)
• Your German language skills correspond to at least level C1
• Ideally, you will bring professional experience from psychiatry – but we are also happy about applications from other specialist areas. With around 1,400 employees, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. We are on the road digitally and are committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage. As soon as your application has been received by us online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. We are happy to get to know you based on your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. Then we will contact you. During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. In the second round we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. You also get the opportunity to get to know your future team. You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide for you after the second interview and ask you if you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will draw up your contract. In the following days we will send you the contract by post in double. The contract also provides you with relevant information about your employment. Between the acceptance of the job and the first working day, you as a new employee can already access relevant internal information. So you can get a differentiated picture of the company and already prepare for the job. On the first day you can expect an onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues. You set up at the new workplace and get an overview of your next tasks. You also get your individual introduction plan, which helps you to find your way around quickly.
